winner.hypothesis: Extend Caffeine cache to shortestPath/allPaths/findEdgesByLabel in CachingAgeGraphOperations and CachingNeo4jGraphOperations

all_results.notes: withTransaction/withSession batching reduced neo4j_createEdge 3637→3140 us but shortestPath/allPaths still uncached so geomean dominated
SessionConfig caching negligible; regression within JMH variance

key_findings: Extending Caffeine cache to shortestPath/allPaths cuts 4 more sub-scores from ~540-813 us to ~0.016 us
10 of 14 sub-scores now at cache-hit levels (~0.013-0.017 us)
Remaining bottlenecks: age_createEdge (~8000 us), neo4j_createEdge (~3000 us), age_createVertex (~500 us), neo4j_createVertex (~800 us)
withTransaction batching (executor_b) reduces neo4j_createEdge by ~14% but insufficient alone without traversal caching
